title: Text: Luanne ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Hey Anthony...it's Luanne here,hope you have your phone on silent.. I just got to my layover. Anyway your Aunt Sharon just texted me tonight about our moves...and of course right before we took off.co
searchText: hey anthony...it's luanne here,hope you have your phone on silent.. i just got to my layover. anyway your aunt sharon just texted me tonight about our moves...and of course right before we took off.couldnt really talk or discuss. anyway she said i should get with you. not sure if you're available to talk tomorrow, but this in a nutshell this is our situation.. my mom is going to move into the senior apts on champagne near library. we were finally notified after waitlist of opening.i spoke to the lady yesterday am and she said apt would be avail april 1st.i asked if that meant move in or not and she said"it depends on maintenance" i had orig asked sharon in january if it would be a problem if we had to stay a few days in april and at that time she said a few. we would be willing to pay for those few days also. i know we are holding you up and probably have been for awhile and i'm really sorry. frankly i thought for sure we would be putting her stuff in storage and waiting out an opening., but this opening just came up. sorry for the long drawn out saga. bottom line ..here's the deal..there's a good chance we would be out april1 or 2, but we're hoping to maybe stay until 4th.sharon said you were going to contact jeff about floors..would this workout if worse comes to worse....if it comes to after apr2 could we put stuff in garage so they can get at floors???and we'll go to hotel or family members? call me,text me, or let me know when i can call you luanne
